sentiment.rationale: The company reported Q1 results in line with expectations (comparable sales down 1.7%, EPS of $2.92) and affirmed its full-year 2025 outlook unchanged. Management language is confident but acknowledges ongoing headwinds (DIY big-ticket pressure, macro uncertainty, weather impacts). There is no guidance raise or material beat relative to prior guidance, and the forward outlook is held flat with cautious language about the consumer environment. This is a routine in-line quarter with stable guidance, warranting a neutral score.

summary.eps: $2.92 diluted EPS, compared to $3.06 in Q1 2024
summary.guidance: Affirming full year 2025 outlook: total sales $83.5-$84.5 billion, comparable sales flat to up 1%, operating margin 12.3%-12.4%, diluted EPS $12.15-$12.40
summary.margin: Gross margin 33.4% of sales, up 19 bps; operating margin 11.9%, down 50 bps

Unfavorable weather earlier in the quarter

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Marvin Ellison stated 'I'm pleased with our team's focus and execution in the face of significant macro uncertainty' and Brandon Sink said 'we remain confident in our team's ability to execute at a high level and manage through this challenging environment as well as any team in retail.'

evidence.claim: Q1 revenue was $20.9 billion with comparable sales down 1.7%
evidence.quote: In the first quarter, we delivered sales of $20.9 billion with comparable sales down 1.7%, in line with our expectations.

evidence.claim: Diluted EPS was $2.92, compared to $3.06 in Q1 2024
evidence.quote: Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) today reported net earnings of $1.6 billion and diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $2.92 for the quarter ended May 2, 2025, compared to diluted EPS of $3.06 in the first quarter of 2024.

Looking forward to the remainder of the year, today we are affirming our fiscal 2025 outlook. We continue to expect sales ranging from $83.5 billion to $84.5 billion with comparable sales in a range of flat to up 1%. We expect operating margin in a range of 12.3% to 12.4% and full year diluted earnings per share of approximately $12.15 to $12.40.

evidence.quote: Gross margin was 33.4% of sales in the first quarter, up 19 basis points from last year... Operating margin rate of 11.9% declined 50 basis points versus prior year
